limitations: One short English request, supplied reference transcript, seed42, resident FP16 F5TTS_v1_Base and FP32 Vocos;32 Euler steps. Not a throughput or all-prompt study.

GX omits GPU arithmetic. Recorded scalar and CPU-array values follow original transfers. F.pad and randn shape adapters use recorded concrete sizes after original GPU scalar reads; native guarded runs verify actual shapes. Native unhooked timing restores all adapters.

GX-only STFT/ISTFT shape adapters were introduced based on prior cuFFT runtime failures in other systems; original FFT was not separately tested under GX for F5-TTS. FFT-related work and host dispatch are omitted. Baseline native-only21launches have isolated median sum0.175605ms/request, not an end-to-end correction. No selected GPU prediction misses.

CPU calibration188unresolved of6058instruction samples(3.103%),11unresolved task samples. GX and native CPU hosts differ; GX absolute times overpredict native. This is not a matched-host accuracy study.

Mode2 primary comparison uses one measured request per capture because the original API creates a fresh worker each request and partial per-thread clocks do not directly synchronize. The initial two-request diagnostic is retained. Mode3 uses caller request intervals across two requests with10us epochs. Worker/caller intervals must not be averaged together.
Native ABBA has3warmups and7measured requests per process;14samples/variant,all retained. Candidate process medians differ (roughly0.572 and0.594s); report pooled mean and median plus all samples.

Solver-only ablation had0.302%mode2 gain and no independent native validation. Selected comparison combines that specialization with request-scoped rotary trigonometric reuse. Gains include reduced GPU work as well as CPU dispatch.
